data.body:
Evidence that the apply has not happened, for the `[non-codebase]` AC.

The nightly Terraform drift sweep (`terraform-drift.yml`, run 41400702900, 2026-11-01 23:33 PDT -- the first sweep after this ticket's Terraform merged) reports DETECTED with exactly one pending change:

```
# aws_iam_role_policy.bedrock_converse will be updated in-place
~ Resource = [
      "arn:aws:bedrock:*::foundation-model/anthropic.claude-*",
    + "arn:aws:bedrock:*::foundation-model/amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0",
```

So the committed configuration and the live role differ by precisely the grant this ticket adds, and by nothing else. The 14 codebase ACs are satisfied; the gap is the apply itself.

What remains is operator-only and has no agent path: run `terraform apply` against `infra/terraform/`, then make a real Titan embedding call from the Gerrit instance role and record the returned dimension count here together with the Gerrit change number, the revision SHA, the UTC timestamp, and the operator identity.

Until that comment exists this ticket cannot honestly close, and it is the sole remaining blocker on [rebar:4e89-30b9-1666-4e53] -> [rebar:a350-2e7e-71eb-4f5b] -> [rebar:62dc-535b-5d05-421d].
